# NBC News

> Breaking news, live coverage, and reporting on U.S., world, politics, business, health, science, culture, and local stories.

NBC News is a national news publisher covering major developing stories, analysis, video, and local reporting from NBC-owned stations in key U.S. markets. The site also includes consumer shopping coverage through NBC Select and audience tip submission channels.

## Main News Sections
- [Home](https://www.nbcnews.com): Front page for breaking headlines, featured reporting, and live news updates.
- [Politics](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics): National politics coverage, elections, Congress, White House, and policy news.
- [U.S. News](https://www.nbcnews.com/us-news): Domestic breaking news, crime, weather, courts, and national reporting.
- [World](https://www.nbcnews.com/world): International news, conflicts, diplomacy, and global developments.
- [Science](https://www.nbcnews.com/science): Reporting on space, climate, research, and scientific discoveries.
- [Sports](https://www.nbcnews.com/sports): Sports headlines, major events, athletes, and related news coverage.
- [Culture Matters](https://www.nbcnews.com/culture-matters): Stories on culture, identity, media, and social trends.
- [Select](https://www.nbcnews.com/select): Consumer shopping guides, product recommendations, and deal coverage.

## Politics Coverage
- [Politics](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics): Central hub for political reporting, analysis, and campaign coverage.
- [Politics News](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/politics-news): Latest political headlines, developments, and breaking updates.
- [Congress](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/congress): Coverage of the House, Senate, legislation, and leadership battles.
- [White House](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/white-house): Reporting on the president, administration actions, and executive policy.
- [Supreme Court](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/supreme-court): News and analysis on major rulings and court-related developments.
- [2024 Election](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2024-election): Election coverage, candidates, polling, and campaign developments.

## U.S. and National Reporting
- [U.S. News](https://www.nbcnews.com/us-news): National reporting on major domestic stories and breaking events.
- [Investigations](https://www.nbcnews.com/investigations): In-depth investigative reporting and accountability journalism.
- [Business](https://www.nbcnews.com/business): Coverage of the economy, markets, companies, and consumer finance.
- [Health](https://www.nbcnews.com/health): Medical news, public health reporting, and wellness coverage.
- [Tech & Media](https://www.nbcnews.com/tech-media): Reporting on technology companies, platforms, AI, and digital culture.
- [Weather](https://www.nbcnews.com/weather): Forecasts, storm coverage, climate impacts, and severe weather news.

## World and Science
- [World](https://www.nbcnews.com/world): Global news coverage with reporting from international regions and conflicts.
- [Europe](https://www.nbcnews.com/world/europe): News from European countries, politics, and regional developments.
- [Asia](https://www.nbcnews.com/world/asia): Coverage of major stories across East, South, and Southeast Asia.
- [Middle East](https://www.nbcnews.com/world/middle-east): Reporting on conflicts, diplomacy, and regional affairs.
- [Africa](https://www.nbcnews.com/world/africa): News and features from across the African continent.
- [Science](https://www.nbcnews.com/science): Science reporting spanning research, environment, and discovery.
- [Space](https://www.nbcnews.com/science/space): Coverage of NASA, launches, astronomy, and space exploration.
- [Climate in Crisis](https://www.nbcnews.com/climate-in-crisis): Reporting on climate change, extreme weather, and environmental policy.

## Lifestyle, Culture, and Consumer
- [Culture Matters](https://www.nbcnews.com/culture-matters): Coverage of culture, race, identity, and social issues.
- [Pop Culture](https://www.nbcnews.com/pop-culture): Entertainment news, celebrity coverage, and cultural trends.
- [Shopping / Select](https://www.nbcnews.com/select): Product guides, expert recommendations, and shopping advice.
- [Select Deals](https://www.nbcnews.com/select/deals): Curated deal coverage across tech, home, beauty, and more.
- [Select Wellness](https://www.nbcnews.com/select/wellness): Shopping and service recommendations focused on health and wellness.
- [Select Giftable Tech](https://www.nbcnews.com/select/giftable-tech): Tech product recommendations and buying guides for consumers.
- [Amazon Big Spring Sale Deals](https://www.nbcnews.com/select/shopping/amazon-big-spring-sale-deals-2026-rcna264802): Deal roundup and shopping coverage for Amazon's seasonal sale event.

## Video and Live Coverage
- [Video](https://www.nbcnews.com/video): News clips, interviews, explainers, and featured video reports.
- [Nightly News](https://www.nbcnews.com/nightly-news): Video segments and reporting from NBC Nightly News.
- [Meet the Press](https://www.nbcnews.com/meet-the-press): Political interviews, analysis, and full episodes from the Sunday program.
- [Dateline](https://www.nbcnews.com/dateline): True crime reporting, episodes, and related Dateline coverage.
- [MSNBC](https://www.nbcnews.com/msnbc): Access point for MSNBC coverage and political video content.
- [Live](https://www.nbcnews.com/now): Live streaming news video and continuously updated coverage.

## Local News Hubs
- [New York](https://www.nbcnews.com/new-york): Local headlines, weather, and video from the New York area.
- [Los Angeles](https://www.nbcnews.com/los-angeles): Local reporting, breaking news, and video from Los Angeles.
- [Chicago](https://www.nbcnews.com/chicago): Chicago-area local news, weather, and community coverage.
- [Dallas-Fort Worth](https://www.nbcnews.com/dallas-fort-worth): Local headlines and reporting from North Texas.
- [Philadelphia](https://www.nbcnews.com/philadelphia): Philadelphia-area news, weather, and local video coverage.
- [Washington, D.C.](https://www.nbcnews.com/washington): Local news and regional reporting from the D.C. area.
- [Boston](https://www.nbcnews.com/boston): Boston-area headlines, weather, and community reporting.
- [Bay Area](https://www.nbcnews.com/bay-area): Local news and video from San Francisco Bay Area communities.

## Additional Local Markets
- [South Florida](https://www.nbcnews.com/miami): Local news, weather, and video from South Florida.
- [San Diego](https://www.nbcnews.com/san-diego): San Diego-area reporting, weather, and breaking local coverage.
- [Connecticut](https://www.nbcnews.com/connecticut): Connecticut local headlines, weather, and community news.
- [Local News](https://www.nbcnews.com/local): Directory and entry point for NBC local station coverage.
- [Weather](https://www.nbcnews.com/weather): National weather coverage relevant to local and regional events.

## Audience and Editorial Resources
- [News Tips](https://www.nbcnews.com/tips): Submit tips, documents, and story ideas to NBC News securely.
- [About NBC News](https://www.nbcnews.com/information/nbc-news-info/about-nbc-news-rcna25680): Overview of NBC News and its editorial organization.
- [Contact Us](https://www.nbcnews.com/information/nbc-news-info/contact-us-nbc-news-digital-rcna25091): Contact information for NBC News Digital and audience inquiries.
- [Corrections](https://www.nbcnews.com/information/nbc-news-info/nbc-news-digital-corrections-rcna25090): Corrections policy and published fixes for NBC News Digital.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.nbcuniversal.com/privacy): Privacy practices for NBCUniversal digital properties.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.nbc.com/general/pages/terms): Terms governing use of NBC digital services.
